description: Return a live PriceLabs quote and payment totals for checkIn, checkOut, guests, and optional petCount (defaults to 0). The quote expires in 30 minutes and does not reserve dates. The response includes humanSteps and handoff for the checkout steps and the quote window. Payment stays on the website.

checkIn.description: Check-in date as YYYY-MM-DD in America/Los_Angeles.

petCount.description: Dogs or cats, 0 to 2. Defaults to 0 when omitted.
